बॉक्स ऑफिस पर रजनीकांत का जादू फिर से चल गया है दोस्तों! 🔥

North America में Jailer 2 ने 13 days में एक बड़ा इतिहास रच दिया है।
10 days में ब्रेक-इवन हासिल करने के बाद इस तमिल फिल्म ने कुल $7.41 million (लगभग 70.58 करोड़ रुपये) की कमाई कर ली है।
फिल्म ने अपनी ही पुरानी फिल्म Jailer ($7.25 million) का रिकॉर्ड तोड़कर Kollywood की सबसे बड़ी फिल्म का खिताब जीता है।
13th day पर $172K की कमाई के साथ फिल्म ने 12th day के $62K के मुकाबले 177.42% की तगड़ी बढ़त दर्ज की।
कुल $910K (8.67 करोड़ रुपये) के मुनाफे के साथ अब यह फिल्म $8 million के मील के पत्थर की तरफ बढ़ रही है। 🚀

क्या November 5 को Ramayana रिलीज होने से पहले Jailer 2 यह नया मुकाम हासिल कर पाएगी? कमेंट्स में बताएं! 👇

ctx.title: Jailer 2 North America Box Office: Becomes Kollywood’s Highest-Grossing Film Of All Time In 13 Days
ctx.summary:
Rajinikanth's Jailer 2 has turned out to be a big success story at the North American box office, earning $7.4 million in 13 days. 
 The post  Jailer 2 North America Box Office: Becomes Kollywood’s Highest-Grossing Film Of All Time In 13 Days  appeared first on  Koimoi .
ctx.text:
Rajinikanth’s Jailer 2 was chasing a big target at the North American box office (USA and Canada) to break even, and it comfortably achieved it in 10 days. After this, everyone was excited to see how fast it would make history as Kollywood’s highest-grossing film in the territory, and guess what? The magnum opus has completed the mission on its second Tuesday, i.e., day 13. Keep reading for a detailed collection report!
The Tamil action-comedy thriller grossed $172K on its second Tuesday, the 13th day. Compared to day 12’s $62K , it displayed a solid jump of 177.42%. Overall, it has grossed a whopping $7.41 million at the North American box office. It equals 70.58 crore in Indian rupees. From here, the $8 million milestone looks within reach.
With $7.41 million, Jailer 2 has now become Kollywood’s highest-grossing film in history in North America. It surpassed its own predecessor, Jailer ( $7.25 million ), to claim the top spot. The film is on track to become the first Tamil film to gross $8 million.
Take a look at Kollywood’s top 10 grossers in North America:
For those who don’t know, Jailer 2 needed $6.5 million ( 61.91 crore ) to break even in North America. In 13 days, the film has amassed $7.41 million, thus recording a profit of $910K ( 8.67 crore ). It’ll be interesting to see how far it goes in profits as Ramayana witnesses a big release on November 5.
